title: Speaking – Test 2
p1: How do you get to school every day? (Do you usually travel by car? Why/Why not?)
What did you do last weekend? (Did you do anything last weekend? What?)
Do you think that English will be useful for you in the future? Why/Why not?
How often do you use a computer? (What do you use a computer for?)

p3.title: Starting a youth club
task: Your local council has been given some money to start a new youth club in your area.
Here are some ideas for a youth club.
Talk together about the different things that might be good to have in the youth club, and decide which thing would be the one to spend the most money on.

p4: Are you a member of a youth club? (If not, would you like to be one?)
What activities would you like to take part in? (Why?)
Do you think children today waste their free time sometimes? (Why?)
Can you learn useful skills for your life from a youth club?
Does doing activities together help someone make new friends?
